part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `handleHTTPRequest` at gin.go:759: unmatched routes called `serveError(c, http.StatusOK, default404Body)`, so requests to undefined routes returned 200 (with the "404 page not found" body). Changed `http.StatusOK` → `http.StatusNotFound`.

Verification:
- All routing tests pass: `TestNoRouteWithoutGlobalHandlers`, `TestNoRouteWithGlobalHandlers`, plus the full `TestRoute|TestNoRoute|TestNotFound|Test404|TestServeError|TestMethodNot` set across all packages
- `go vet` clean
- Full-suite failures (`TestSaveUploadedFile*`, `TestFileDescriptor`) were confirmed pre-existing on the unmodified tree via `git stash` — Windows permission-semantics issues unrelated to routing
